intelligence_requirement: Do these synthetic observations justify checking a specific recipient's identity or mailbox telemetry, and what remains unproven?
intended_reader: A defender or CTI analyst translating a published procedure into an authorised, bounded local evidence request.
reassessment_trigger: Revisit when the source claim or ATT&CK mapping changes, telemetry semantics invalidate an assumption, or a practitioner records an unsuccessful or misleading decision path.
source_claim: A DOJ indictment announcement describes tracking information followed by later targeting. The legal allegations do not establish that any one tracking request proves compromise.
source_locator: Hacking Scheme, opening three paragraphs; Overview of the Malicious Cyber Activity, mailbox-surveillance paragraph; presumption-of-innocence notice.
boundary: All telemetry is fictional and uses reserved .test identities. No malware, live candidate contact, credentials or production log upload. The rule is an exercise answer key, not a detection, attribution or coverage score. Software tests establish repeatability only; representative practitioner outcome validation remains unrecorded.
method: Validate required fields; count records by type; join recipient-confirmed opens to failed sign-ins for the same synthetic identity within one hour; preserve proxy and approved-client alternatives; stop when the relevant telemetry is missing. Temporal association is a question for investigation, not a causal or compromise finding.

cases.title: A security proxy fetched a remote image
Confirmed recipient open, then a failed sign-in
Mailbox reads match a documented approved client
No identity or mailbox telemetry retained
